---- MODULE etcd_raft ----
EXTENDS etcd_raftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AGBag == INSTANCE BagsTheorems

AGActive(i) == state[i] \in {Candidate, Leader}
AGGrant(m) == m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ m.mvoteGranted
AGMessage(m) ==
    /\ m.msource \in Server
    /\ m.mdest \in Server
    /\ m.mterm \in Nat
    /\ m.mtype \in {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse,
                       AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}
AGTypes ==
    /\ config = [i \in Server |-> config[i]]
    /\ durableState = [i \in Server |-> durableState[i]]
    /\ IsABag(messages) /\ IsABag(pendingMessages)
    /\ state \in [Server -> {Follower, Candidate, Leader}]
    /\ currentTerm \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ votedFor \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}]
    /\ votesGranted \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
    /\ \A i \in Server :
           /\ durableState[i].currentTerm \in Nat
           /\ durableState[i].votedFor \in Server \cup {Nil}
           /\ config[i].jointConfig[1] = InitServer
           /\ durableState[i].config.jointConfig[1] = InitServer
    /\ \A m \in DOMAIN messages \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages : AGMessage(m)
AGLinks ==
    \A i \in Server :
       /\ durableState[i].currentTerm <= currentTerm[i]
       /\ (durableState[i].currentTerm = currentTerm[i]
              /\ durableState[i].votedFor # Nil)
             => votedFor[i] = durableState[i].votedFor
       /\ AGActive(i) => votedFor[i] = i
AGPending ==
    \A m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : AGGrant(m) =>
       /\ m.mterm <= currentTerm[m.msource]
       /\ m.mterm = currentTerm[m.msource] => votedFor[m.msource] = m.mdest
AGSent ==
    \A m \in DOMAIN messages : AGGrant(m) =>
       /\ m.mterm <= durableState[m.msource].currentTerm
       /\ m.mterm = durableState[m.msource].currentTerm
             => durableState[m.msource].votedFor = m.mdest
AGGranted ==
    \A c \in Server : AGActive(c) =>
       \A v \in votesGranted[c] :
          /\ currentTerm[c] <= durableState[v].currentTerm
          /\ currentTerm[c] = durableState[v].currentTerm
                => durableState[v].votedFor = c
AGMsgAgree ==
    \A m,n \in DOMAIN messages \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages :
         (AGGrant(m) /\ AGGrant(n) /\ m.msource = n.msource
             /\ m.mterm = n.mterm) => m.mdest = n.mdest
AGMsgVotesAgree ==
    \A m \in DOMAIN messages \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages :
         \A c \in Server :
           (AGGrant(m) /\ AGActive(c) /\ m.msource \in votesGranted[c]
               /\ m.mterm = currentTerm[c]) => m.mdest = c
AGVotesAgree ==
    \A c,d \in Server :
         (AGActive(c) /\ AGActive(d) /\ currentTerm[c] = currentTerm[d]
             /\ votesGranted[c] \cap votesGranted[d] # {}) => c = d
AGConsistent == AGMsgAgree /\ AGMsgVotesAgree /\ AGVotesAgree
AGLeaderQuorum ==
    \A i \in Server : state[i] = Leader =>
       \E Q \in Quorum(InitServer) : Q \subseteq votesGranted[i]
AGElectionInv ==
    /\ AGTypes /\ AGLinks /\ AGPending /\ AGSent
    /\ AGGranted /\ AGConsistent /\ AGLeaderQuorum

LEMMA AGPendingBag ==
    IsABag(pendingMessages) => \A i :
       /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i))
       /\ DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) =
             {agWire \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : agWire.msource = i}
       /\ \A agWire \in DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) :
             PendingMessages(i)[agWire] = pendingMessages[agWire]
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF IsABag, PendingMessages

LEMMA AGBagCompatibility ==
    \A B,C :
       /\ (IsABag(B) <=> AGBag!IsABag(B))
       /\ B (-) C = AGBag!(-)(B,C)
    BY Zenon DEF IsABag, AGBag!IsABag, (-), AGBag!(-)

LEMMA AGSubtractDomain ==
    \A B,C : IsABag(B) /\ IsABag(C) =>
       /\ IsABag(B (-) C)
       /\ DOMAIN (B (-) C) =
             {e \in DOMAIN B : e \notin DOMAIN C \/ B[e] > C[e]}
    BY AGBagCompatibility, AGBag!Bags_Difference, SMTT("r2")

AGKeepVotes ==
    \A c \in Server : (AGActive(c)' /\ votesGranted'[c] # {}) =>
       /\ AGActive(c)
       /\ currentTerm'[c] = currentTerm[c]
       /\ votesGranted'[c] = votesGranted[c]

LEMMA AGConsistentReduction ==
    ( /\ AGConsistent
      /\ {m \in DOMAIN messages' \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages' : AGGrant(m)}
             \subseteq DOMAIN messages \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages
      /\ AGKeepVotes ) => AGConsistent'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGConsistent, AGMsgAgree, AGMsgVotesAgree, AGVotesAgree, AGGrant, AGKeepVotes

LEMMA AGFiniteCompatibility ==
    \A S : /\ (IsFiniteSet(S) <=> AGBag!IsFiniteSet(S))
            /\ Cardinality(S) = AGBag!Cardinality(S)
    BY Zenon DEF IsFiniteSet, AGBag!IsFiniteSet,
                 Cardinality, AGBag!Cardinality

LEMMA AGMajoritiesMeet ==
    \A U,Q,R :
       (IsFiniteSet(U) /\ Q \in Quorum(U) /\ R \in Quorum(U))
          => Q \cap R # {}
<1>1. ASSUME NEW U, NEW Q, NEW R,
             IsFiniteSet(U), Q \in Quorum(U), R \in Quorum(U)
      PROVE Q \cap R # {}
    <2>1. /\ AGBag!IsFiniteSet(U)
          /\ Q \subseteq U /\ R \subseteq U
          /\ AGBag!Cardinality(U) = Cardinality(U)
          /\ AGBag!Cardinality(Q) = Cardinality(Q)
          /\ AGBag!Cardinality(R) = Cardinality(R)
          /\ AGBag!Cardinality(U) \in Nat
          /\ AGBag!Cardinality(Q) \in Nat
          /\ AGBag!Cardinality(R) \in Nat
        BY <1>1, AGFiniteCompatibility, AGBag!FS_Subset,
           AGBag!FS_CardinalityType, SMTT("r10") DEF Quorum
    <2> QED
        BY <1>1, <2>1, AGBag!FS_MajoritiesIntersect, SMTT("r5") DEF Quorum
<1> QED BY <1>1, Zenon
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []LogInv
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF etcd_raft/etcd_raft_LogInv.tla
BY PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF etcd_raft/etcd_raft_LogInv.tla
